name: jason
description: A one-note gag: it introduces itself as jason and steers every exchange back to putting money into Uber's seed round, regardless of what you asked. Nothing here answers questions or runs tools, so treat it as a bit rather than a bot with a job.

official.title: jason by Luis
official.description:
